positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Worked on ServiceNow versions – Xanadu
•	Involved in Employee center Homecourt project. Homecourt is a company’s portal used for all company news and articles which were transition over to ServiceNow employee center (ESC).
•	Involved in digitizing forms using service now catalog item builder, flow designers and setting up some automations on the traditional process like applying for corporate credit card, setting up AD groups, IT event forms, facilities request and so on.
•	Created workflows for Knowledge bases, articles and setting up the processes on the KB articles.
•	Responsible for building and writing ATF test cases and developing Suites and managing Test management cases.
•	Managed CSM by logging and prioritizing the customer support tickets, assigning cases, tracking case progress, updating status and managing case escalations and Resolving customer issues within defined SLAs.
•	Investigate performance issues, learn troubleshooting tools, and use system logs to find issues
•	Creating flow designer’s activities and approvals. Implement new flows that use a variety of activities to understand how records are generated and flow process as per business needs.
•	Responsible for access control, security, enhancements such as form or workflow editing and UAT/Regression testing of any development.
•	Involved in Upgrades and Security Patches from service-now. Responsible for maintaining the regression test of the Environment after the upgrades and Patches.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, ServiceNow Developer
positions.description:
Client: Wells Fargo
·	Worked on ServiceNow versions – Quebec, San Diego, Tokyo
·	Design and implementing new functionality using Business Rules, UI Policies and Access Lists, UI Actions, Script Includes etc.
·	Experience with ServiceNow client and server-side JavaScript-all scripted aspects of the ServiceNow system
·	Configure OOB and custom workflows.
·	Working with CSM, FSM, BCM business Impact Analysis, Business continuity Planning, crisis management and Plan exercising.
·	Identify High risks and failure and act to apply right strategy
·	Develop recovery plans and validate.
·	Sustain, protect and recover Business plans and views.
·	Actively involved in form configurations within the environment to meet the business needs.
·	Configuration of Email Notification and Alerts to notify users about specific activities in the system
·	Performs migration activities Dev to QA, QA to Prod with Agile methodology.
·	Investigate performance issues, learn troubleshooting tools, and use system logs to find issues
·	Creates Workflow activities and approvals. Implement new workflows that use a variety of activities to understand how records are generated from workflows.

projects.title: Wall Crack Detection
projects.description: A Novel crack detection method is proposed based on the digital image of building external wall. We strive to record the wall surface condition accurately, and then get the linear characteristics of the image for crack recognition. first does image edge detection, image binary of adaptive threshold and removal of isolated points, obtaining effective linear characteristics. Finally we distinguish the cracks and the normal lines through the curve fitting and its parameter analysis.
